P7.text: So ask yourself. Are you, every single one of you, better than the Prophet Muhammad in spending time with your parents? Akhi, the Prophet did not have a father. When he was born, he didn't even have a father. He sallallahu alayhi wa sallam only established six years of his life with his mother. Every single one of you have lived more than six years with your parents. The Prophet hasn't lived more than six years with his mother. And you wonder, Akhi, if his parents were alive. The standard that the Prophet probably set for us, for our parents, Akhi, I don't believe any of us would enter Jannah if his parents was alive.

T17.text: I'm gonna ask you this question. If you got the phone call right now that your mother is in her final moments, or your father is in his final moments in the hospital, how would you feel, bro? Would you leave off the girl that you're with in the car, doing balloons or drugs with? Would you leave the mandem? Would you leave the haram? Are you gonna be in the state of committing zina in that same moment you get that phone call? So go and say goodbye to your mother and your father.

D17.text: Do you not fear the day where the angel of death comes to visit you? And there is no amount of respect, love, care, money, wealth that you could do to try and bribe death in order for your soul not to return back to Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala. Allah gave an order. He gave her order to the angel of death. Go and bring Abdullah's soul back. Go and bring Fatima's soul back. Zahra, Abdul Karim, Abdul Haq, whoever it may be, go and bring their souls back to me. Because inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. To Allah we belong and to Allah we shall return.

D20.text: Mothers, I beg of you. When your children are making mistakes, instead of having this authority of a parent over your kids, I beg of you, I beg of you, talk to your kids as a friend and not as a parent. Sometimes having that authority of a parent over your kids destroys their mindset. You're too busy, quick to resort to violence or slapping them. We're better than this. The Prophet, a little shabab, a little youth came up to him and he said, Ya Rasulullah, allow me to commit zina. Brother, I dare. I dare one of the mandem to come up to me and say, brother, allow me to commit zina as well. I'll slap him. I'll stop him. But look at the ethics of the Prophet. What did he do? He lowered himself to the same level as this youth. And he said to him, would you like it for your mother? Would you like it for your sister or daughter? And because of that, the young man didn't commit zina out of fear.

P8.text: We have a cheat code, bro, that gets us into Jannah, but our cheat codes have become the cheat codes of GTA. Brother, let me do a cheat code so my money can go up. Let me do a cheat code so I can get a jet ski or get a car or do this. And if your Qur'an has dust on it, bro, Akhi, best believe you need to question yourself. If your salah has gone to waste, Akhi, continue to only blame yourself for your position in life.

T22.text: That you are committed. From today. From today, that you are committed. That every single day you will leave your phone in your room, and you would spend at least two hours with no distraction. No distraction of your phone. No pinging. It's on silent. You leave it in the room. You spend two hours with your parents downstairs, do whatever you will. If your mum is in the kitchen, whatever, maybe, you spend two hours with them, bro. No distraction with your phone. You go and do this, committed, Akhi. The small acts that you do that are consistent are most beloved to Allah.

D11.text: The ummah is suffering, and the backbone of this ummah are the women of our families. The women that are God-fearing. The women that establish the Quran and the Sunnah. The women that take care of their husbands. The women that take care of their kids. The women that are single mothers. Hats off to you, sister. You're the backbone of this ummah, because it is you that will lead, and that will raise someone that will bring the victory to this ummah, because of the misery that we're stuck in.

D21.text: Any brother or sister that has an issue with you prioritizing the worship of Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala, that is a brother or sister you need to keep away from completely. I'm not telling you to cut ties with them, but take a step away from them. Take a step away from these people. Imagine you're like, I need to go pray. Ah, here we go. What do you mean, bro? You can't be around me. Imagine if I die, is this person still gonna worship Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala after my death and make dua for me? No, they won't. They will go back to their haram relationship and talking to guys. All the girls, for the mandem, they're gonna forget about you. So isolation is a good thing. But you should never be isolated when you're in the house of Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala.

T10.text: And the Tabi'een mention something so profound and so beautiful. They say that Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala created the angels with intellect. And then Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala created the animals with desires. But Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala also created the insan, which is me and you, with both the intellect and the desires. So whoever follows their desires will be as low as the dogs. As low as the animals. And whoever follows the intellect would be as high as the malaika, as high as the angels, if not even higher than them, in the eyes of Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala.

T8.text: I want you to try and be in the same gathering as the companions. I want you to try and visualize it. The Prophet Muhammad, he was in the gathering like this, and he said, I miss my brothers. I miss my brothers. The companions were baffled. What are you talking about, Ya Rasulullah? Are we not your brothers? You are my companions. My brothers are those that will come after you. Those that believe in me and follow my Sunnah. Those that haven't even seen me, those that haven't even heard my voice. Who is he talking about, bro? He's talking about every single one of you here.

D8.text: We all want victory, right? You want victory? What is victory, bro? That's the akhirah. What is victory in this dunya? Victory in this dunya, let me make it clear to every single one of you, is to follow the Quran and the Sunnah to the best of your abilities. That's victory, bro. The more we educate ourselves by following the Quran and the way of the Prophet and the companions that were around him, the more we will be victorious within ourselves. As Allah says, save yourselves first and then your family.

D27.text: What's the one thing that I love the most and hate the most in this dunya? Okay. One thing that I love the most in this dunya is the fact that I'm a Muslim, bro. There's no better identity than that. Muslim. Be confident within yourself that Allah chose you to wake up today to be a believer, a Muslim. That's what I love. What I hate is the opportunities for me to go to Jahannam. That's what I hate, Akhi. And the opportunity lies within my own desires, within my own sins, and that's what I hate and that's what I fear. That I will go to Jahannam.
